title: Parseval identity on Fourier support
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let its Fourier support be the collection of subsets with nonzero Fourier coefficient. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over this support equals the uniform average of $f(x)^2$ over the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
